framework_source.title: AP Chemistry Course and Exam Description

chemistry_reference.title: Chemistry
chemistry_reference.scope_rule: Use only CED-relevant material at the student-depth target established by the teacher materials.

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Introduction to AP Chemistry
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Significant figures, temperature scale and thermometer reading, nomenclature, and basic mole calculations

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Stoichiometry
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Atomic theory, average atomic mass, mass spectrometry, Avogadro's number, percent composition, empirical and molecular formulas, stoichiometry, limiting/excess reactants, and percent yield

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Chemical Reactions
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Precipitation, acid-base and oxidation-reduction reactions, net ionic equations, particulate representations, electrolytes, oxidation numbers, and oxidized/reduced species

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Introduction to Solutions
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Molarity, dilutions, solution stoichiometry, precipitates, and acid-base titrations

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Gases
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Gas properties, pressure, gas-law relationships, kinetic-molecular reasoning, and gas calculations

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Basic Thermochemistry
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Heat, energy transfer, thermochemical equations, and enthalpy-change calculations

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Electrons and Periodicity
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Electron configurations, orbital diagrams, periodic trends, Coulomb's law, ionic radii, photoelectron spectroscopy, and the electromagnetic spectrum

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Chemical Bonding, Intermolecular Forces and Properties of Solids
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Bond types and polarity, alloys, Lewis structures, resonance, VSEPR, molecular polarity, formal charge, bond order, internuclear distance, bond strength, hybridization, sigma/pi bonds, phase changes, intermolecular forces, liquids, and solids

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Advanced Solutions
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Molarity review, solution formation, mixture separation, solubility curves, solution preparation and glassware, solution energy changes, and Beer's law

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Chemical Kinetics
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Reaction rates, rate laws, concentration change over time, elementary reactions, collision model, reaction-energy profiles, mechanisms, pre-equilibrium approximation, and catalysis

teacher_instructional_materials.title: General Equilibrium
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Dynamic equilibrium, equilibrium constants, equilibrium calculations, reaction quotient reasoning, and Le Châtelier-type changes

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Acid and Base Equilibrium
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Strong and weak acids/bases, acid-base models, conjugate pairs, pH, equilibrium constants, buffers, and titration reasoning

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Solubility Product Constant: Ksp
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Solubility equilibria, Ksp expressions, molar solubility, ICE-table patterns, and precipitation calculations

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Advanced Thermochemistry
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Enthalpy review, Hess's law, formation enthalpy, entropy, free energy, thermodynamic favorability, and related calculations

teacher_instructional_materials.title: Electrochemistry
teacher_instructional_materials.declared_coverage: Redox review, galvanic/voltaic cells, electrolytic cells, cell potential and free energy, nonstandard conditions, electrolysis, and Faraday's law

conflict_resolution_contract: CED governs AP scope, unit boundaries, and topic order.
Zumdahl Chemistry 11e governs chemistry accuracy and explanatory truth.
Teacher PowerPoints govern the intended student understanding depth, examples, emphases, and classroom expectations after they are relocated into CED order.
Teacher-supplied scoring guides inform assessment reasoning, representations, and skill demand; they are evidence sources and are not copied verbatim.
When a source conflict appears, record it in the F0B crosswalk. Apply the relevant authority rule explicitly and preserve the conflict record.
